data.name: Noor
data.gender_notes: Noor is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-و-ر (n-w-r), 'to shine, illuminate'. Nūr means 'light'. Its root is ن-و-ر (n-w-r). A Qur'anic word; Sūrat al-Nūr (24) is named after it. Noor is a Arabic name meaning “Light; radiance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Noor expresses “Light; radiance”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-و-ر (n-w-r), 'to shine, illuminate'. Nūr means 'light'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noor total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
